params.description: Adjusts the level of power supply hum that interacts with the signal. Preamp tube heaters in tube amps will leak a little bit of 60 cycle hum into the audio signal. When this hum mixes with the distorted audio signal, a non-musical distortion is created at low levels. To some players, this low-level, non-harmonic distortion adds a bit of realism to the amp model.

params.description: Controls how much AC ripple interacts with your tone. params.name: Treble
params.description: Controls the high frequency EQ of the tonestack.

params.name: Bass
params.description: Controls the low frequency EQ of the tonestack.

params.name: Bright
params.description: When on, boosts high frequencies. Is more obvious when Drive is set low.

params.name: Level
params.description: Level controls the overall level of the Amp block. Unlike Master Volume, it has no effect on the block's tone. Level is a great way to level your presets as you can quickly jump to each Amp block by pressing the Amp button.

params.name: Drive
params.description: Controls the amount of gain applied to the signal, which influences the level of distortion.

params.name: Effect
params.description: Controls the mid EQ of the tonestack, the frequency of which is controlled by the Variamp parameter.

params.name: Hum
params.description: Adjusts the level of power supply hum that interacts with the signal. Preamp tube heaters in tube amps will leak a little bit of 60 cycle hum into the audio signal. When this hum mixes with the distorted audio signal, a non-musical distortion is created at low levels. To some players, this low-level, non-harmonic distortion adds a bit of realism to the amp model.

params.name: Master
params.description: Controls the Master Volume of the amplifier.

params.name: TF Coarse
params.description: Controls the coarse tuning of the Tuning Fork's reference tone.

params.name: TF Fine
params.description: Controls the fine tuning of the Tuning Fork's reference tone.

params.name: Treble
params.description: Controls the high frequency EQ of the tonestack.

params.name: Tuning Fork
params.description: Controls the volume of the Tuning Fork's reference tone. Included only in the interest of hyper-accuracy.

params.name: Variamp
params.description: This 5-position switch acts selects the mid frequency to be boosted or cut with the Effect parameter.
